description:
CLI Dotnet Tool for the Kubernetes Operator SDK.
            Helps with generating CRDs and other elements for the Operator.
releaseNotes:
'## [14.0.0](https://github.com/dotnet/dotnet-operator-sdk/compare/v13.3.6...v14.0.0) (2026-11-17)

### ⚠ BREAKING CHANGES

* See the [migration guide](https://dotnet.github.io/dotnet-operator-sdk/docs/operator/migration#upgrading-from-v13-to-v14) for upgrading from v13 to v14.
* **client:** remove JsonPatch.Net and the synchronous client API (#1319)
* **web:** replace LocalTunnel with external webhook endpoints (#1301)
* **core:** add .NET 11 support and drop .NET 8 and .NET 9 (#1285)
